summary: Play Lichess games, challenge players, solve puzzles, or play offline.
release_notes: Clarifies saved-game, challenge and pairing recovery messages. A delayed match check now says it is waiting to check again and keeps cancellation available.

steps.text: Create a Lichess Personal Access Token granting only board:play.
Save the token in a private local file, then install it under the exact secret name lichess.
Use Cobalt 0.3.5 or newer. This app uses the responsive Folio interface in protocol 12.
Official Lichess Board API. Rapid and Classical seeks.

user: Somebody who plays on Lichess and wants the board on e-ink.
job: Play Lichess games, challenge players, and solve puzzles, with real offline play too.
offline: Offline games and puzzles already fetched work without the network; live games and challenges need it.
